id.title: Balance history configuration identifier
id.description: Unique identifier of the balance history configuration generated by Pismo.

target_type.title: Target Type
target_type.description: Defines the hierarchical level to which the balance history configuration applies.

target_id.title: Target Identifier
target_id.description: Unique identifier of the target to which the configuration applies.

division_code.title: Division code unique identifier
division_code.description: Code string that uniquely identifies the division within your organization.

cycle_closing_time.title: Determines the closing date to set the balances for the following day.

cycle_event_delay.title: The time in minutes the balance history events will be sent after the cycle_closing_datetime.

cycle_config_validity.title: Cycle date validity
cycle_config_validity.description: Object for the validity date of the configuration.

start.title: Cycle date validity start
start.description: The effective date of the configuration in the division's timezone.
